item.title: Alabama SMACKS Kiffin, but Tide better BE CAREFUL! w/ Kevin Scarbinsky 😧 The viral double-beer fan!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Alabama just smacked LSU in Baton Rouge, putting the Crimson Tide back in the driver's seat towards the College Football Playoff. Kevin Scarbinsky joins Ben Flanagan to break down how Bama dominated the Tigers, what it means for Kalen DeBoer, and if Tide fans are ready to move on from Lane Kiffin. They also look ahead to Vanderbilt and how DeBoer can avoid another letdown in Nashville, break down the Iron Bowl, react to the death of the SEC Championship Game, and share some early thoughts on Bama hoops. Also, Nick Morgan, the viral Alabama fan double-fisting beers in that photo at the LSU game, is here to tell us all about it!
